title: Temporal Memory for Robust Navigation under Distribution Shift: A Controlled Benchmark
description: A controlled benchmark comparing a memoryless MLP policy (PPO) against a recurrent LSTM policy (RecurrentPPO) on a goal-occlusion navigation task. Both policies are evaluated under three conditions of increasing difficulty: in-distribution, the training distribution (mild domain randomization), and an unseen severe distribution shift. The LSTM degrades by only 8 percentage points under severe shift, while the MLP collapses by 30. This repository contains all code, trained models, evaluation scripts, and paper source.
